title: Sex differences in reddish-purple color preference
statement:
Biological components of sex differences reveal a universal female preference toward the reddish-purple region of the color spectrum compared to males.

Options:
- Female Demographic Skew: #9C27B0 (Reddish-Purple) (fits: women apparel, cosmetics)
- Male Demographic Skew: #009688 (Blue-Green) (fits: men grooming, hardware)
- Gender Neutral: #607D8B (Neutral Blue-Grey) (fits: utilities, b2b software)
appliesWhen: Applies to: consumer goods, apparel ecommerce. Audience: adults.

source.title: Biological Components of Sex Differences in Color Preference
